outcome: neurodevelopmental impairment (cerebral palsy, severe visual impairment, hearing impairment, cognitive impairment)
cohort: Infants born in Korea during 2013-2017 with a birth weight <500 g and gestational age >=22 weeks, registered in the Korean Neonatal Network, were followed up at 18-24 months corrected age.
finding: Half of infants with a birth weight <500 g in Korea exhibited neurodevelopmental impairment and growth retardation at a corrected age of 18-24 months.
